non_claims: Finite/random computation does not prove the universal Moore-minimization or convex-state theorems.

residual_risks: No independent implementation of Moore minimization was used beyond exhaustive future-prefix checks on sampled machines.
Floating geometric checks use tolerances and random directions/matrices.
Global minimality of the combined observer-convex packet is not claimed.
